description:
After reviewing the latest L2 parameter set for the edge switch, the bridge‑group proxy ARP feature is enabled, while the overall bridge setting remains disabled. The bridge age timeout has been set to 30 seconds, and the maximum bridge collisions allowed is 12. GARP on the virtual‑ID interface is turned on, but GARP replies are disabled. MAC‑mode forwarding of our own packets is enabled, and MBF instance learning is also enabled. The periodic MBF peer‑MAC update interval is configured to 5 seconds. Proxy ARP at the bridge level is active, whereas returning traffic to the Ethernet sender is disabled. Reset on interface for HA fail‑over is enabled, and we have chosen not to skip proxying BSD traffic. The stop‑MAC‑move update mechanism is enabled, but the use‑my‑MAC option is currently disabled.  

These settings reflect a policy where automatic address learning and MAC management are active, but certain reply and fallback behaviors are intentionally suppressed to avoid unintended traffic loops. Please verify that these parameters align with the intended network design and let me know if any adjustments are required.
